snippet.title: Becoming None's Kickstarter is live now!
snippet.description:
The Becoming None Kickstarter launches tomorrow! 

Don't miss this opportunity and be part of a game that will be remembered. 
Becoming None stands out with a brand new narrative style never seen before in other games, a deep and unforgettable story, a system blending the collectathon genre with JRPGs, and an incredibly fun and deep combat system that, while inspired by Shin Megami Tensei, is distinct and innovative. 

Kickstarter rewards range from getting your name in the credits to designing a monster, a playable skin that everyone can use, and much more!

Here are the game links:

Kickstarter:

https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/pantaro/becoming-none

Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4739510/Becoming_None/
